title: Nourishing Korean Rhubarb Jorim
description: A malty and glassy-jelly Korean dish featuring forced rhubarb, perfect for a post-workout meal, made in a paella pan and shaped like nigiri.
instructions: In a large paella pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cut rhubarb and cook for 5 minutes, or until it starts to soften.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Korean malt syrup and water.
Pour the malt syrup mixture over the rhubarb and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the rhubarb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season with low-sodium salt and black pepper to taste.
Use a spatula to shape the rhubarb mixture into small nigiri shapes.
Serve the Nourishing Korean Rhubarb Jorim warm or at room temperature.
